# Cyber Kings - Sci-Fi Culture Appearances (generated by _dev/scripts/race_looks/gen_all.py; do not hand-edit)
# Portrait / script triggers. A character is of a people when it carries ck_race_<people> (see race_data.py).

ck_is_antecessor_trigger = { has_character_flag = ck_race_antecessor }
ck_is_ergaster_trigger = { has_character_flag = ck_race_ergaster }
ck_ergaster_has_hair_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson
		has_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn
		has_character_flag = ck_hair_raven
	}
}
ck_ergaster_has_shade_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1
		has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2
		has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3
		has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4
		has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5
	}
}

# The people a culture belongs to (race tradition, CONTENT_REGISTER "Race traditions"). Used only when stamping.
ck_culture_is_antecessor_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_antecessor } }
ck_culture_is_ergaster_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_ergaster } }
ck_culture_is_archon_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_archon } }
ck_culture_is_aeon_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_aeon } }
ck_culture_is_neanderthal_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_neanderthal } }
ck_culture_is_jotnar_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_jotnar } }
ck_culture_is_cathrian_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_cathrian } }
ck_culture_is_mau_khet_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_mau_khet } }
ck_culture_is_thark_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_thark } }
ck_culture_is_torquas_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_torquas } }
ck_culture_is_phaeter_trigger = { exists = culture culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ck_phaeter } }
ck_culture_is_auroran_trigger = { exists = culture culture = culture:spacer }
ck_culture_is_tauceti_trigger = { exists = culture culture = culture:celestial }
